App.title: {name} — Core
App.notDesignated: Not designated — the core is only visible to the GM
App.coreEmpty: The core is empty. The GM may seat a passive item here.
App.coreDropHint: Drop an item from the sidebar, a compendium or an inventory onto the core.
App.nodeEmpty: Nothing is carved here. Choose a rune, or drop an essence or one of your magic items to begin.
App.noProject: Nothing on the bench. Click an empty node to begin a project.
App.workedToday: Already worked today. Available after a long rest or when the day turns.
App.projectInvalid: The source of this project is missing.
App.noEssences: No essences. Disenchant a magic item to harvest one.
App.timedEssence: Essences take the crafting time of their rarity.

rider.weapon: Rider: {bonus} to weapon attack and damage

App.ridersHint: riders do not stack; the highest bonus among the nodes applies.

CorePicker.title: Seat a core
CorePicker.intro: Built-in cores. Seating one replaces whatever is in the core slot; it becomes a feat on the sheet.
CorePicker.replace: The core holds {name}. Replace it with {core}?

Core.consumeMissing: No feature named {feature} was found on the sheet, so {item} is not linked to it. Set its consumption by hand once the feature exists.

Awakened.title: Awakened Core
Awakened.prompt: Choose the score that increases by 1 until the next long rest (to a maximum of 20).
Awakened.chosen: Awakened Core: {ability} +1 until the next long rest.
Awakened.capped: {ability} is already 20; Awakened Core grants nothing this rest.

Essence.harvestedFrom: Harvested from {name}. Slot it into a node of the Wanderer's core to carry its power.

Picker.title: Carve — {slot}
Picker.view: View in the Wanderer Runes compendium
Picker.aidNote: Master rune-crafters may be able to aid him in the work, particularly with very rare runes. It would be worth asking.

Craft.replaceProject: Abandon the current project ({name}) and lose its progress?
Craft.occupiedAtStart: {slot} holds {name}. It stays in place and keeps working until the new carving is finished, then it is replaced. Continue?
Craft.alreadyWorked: The Wanderer has already worked today.
Craft.sourceMissing: The source of this project ({name}) no longer exists.
Craft.runeTaken: {name} is already carved into the core.
Craft.notOwner: You do not own this actor.
Craft.mustCarve: Runes and cores reach the sheet only through the Wanderer's core: carve it, or have the GM seat it.

Chat.disenchanted: {actor} breaks down {item} and draws out its essence.
Chat.coreSet: {name} is seated in the Wanderer's core.

Drop.coreGmOnly: Only the GM can place something in the core.
Drop.gmNodeContent: Install it directly, bypassing crafting, or disenchant it into an essence and begin crafting?
Drop.disenchantConfirm: Disenchant {name}? The item is destroyed, its essence is harvested, and crafting into {slot} begins.
Drop.notAllowed: Only essences or magic items from the Wanderer's own inventory can be dropped on a node.
Drop.runeOnCore: Runes cannot be carved into the core.

Disenchant.title: Disenchant
Disenchant.intro: Break a magic item down into an essence. The item is destroyed; the essence can later be slotted into a node.
Disenchant.none: No magic items in the inventory.

Remove.confirm: Remove {name} from {slot}? Runes are lost; essences return to the inventory.
Remove.coreGmOnly: Only the GM can remove the core item.

Designate.confirm: Designate {name} as the Wanderer? This enables the core for the actor's owners.
Designate.none: No actor is designated as the Wanderer. Open a character sheet as GM and use its Core button.

daysCommon.name: Crafting days: Common
daysCommon.hint: Days of work to craft a common rune or essence.

daysUncommon.name: Crafting days: Uncommon
daysUncommon.hint: Days of work to craft an uncommon rune or essence (DMG: 10).

daysRare.name: Crafting days: Rare
daysRare.hint: Days of work to craft a rare rune or essence (DMG: 50).

daysVeryRare.name: Crafting days: Very rare
daysVeryRare.hint: Days of work to craft a very rare rune or essence (DMG: 125).

daysLegendary.name: Crafting days: Legendary
daysLegendary.hint: Days of work to slot a legendary essence (DMG: 250).

essenceInstant.name: Essences slot instantly
essenceInstant.hint: If enabled, slotting a disenchanted essence takes no crafting time. Otherwise it takes the crafting days of its rarity.

runesConsumeAttunement.name: Carved runes use an attunement slot
runesConsumeAttunement.hint: Each carved rune feature lowers the actor's attunement maximum by one, so the three nodes behave like attuned items. Weapon runes and slotted essences are attuned items in their own right.

chatMessages.name: Post crafting messages to chat
chatMessages.hint: Announce work days, completed carvings and disenchanting in the chat log.

sheetImage.name: Core image
sheetImage.hint: The image shown behind the slots. The default is the Wanderer concept sheet; use the Layout menu to frame it.

libraryMenu.name: Rune library
libraryMenu.label: Open the rune library
libraryMenu.hint: Add, edit, disable or remove runes available for carving.

layoutMenu.name: Core layout
layoutMenu.label: Edit the layout
layoutMenu.hint: Position the four slots over the image and set the image crop.

Library.title: Rune library
Library.resetConfirm: Discard your edits to {name} and restore the built-in version?

Layout.title: Core layout
Layout.intro: Slot positions are percentages of the framed image. The crop is in pixels of the source image.
